grouping.valid_effort: Setup.Date and Retrieval.Date both parse, retrieval >= setup
grouping.time_unit: calendar date (local survey calendar, inclusive endpoints)
grouping.paired_site_period: at least two distinct camera-member IDs AND two distinct Trap.Station.Name IDs within Primary.Site.ID x YearSeason
grouping.paired_operational_interval: at least two camera-member deployments with positive overlap of their validated setup/retrieval calendar-day intervals
grouping.duplicates: same Site x YearSeason x Camera.Name repeated deployments remain nested in same camera, never count as independent physical camera
grouping.location_consistency: within-site longitude and latitude range each <=0.02 decimal degrees; otherwise flag site-identity coordinate conflict

geography.construction: purely response-independent balanced longitudinal blocks derived from physical site coordinates
geography.rule: for each stable physical Site take median longitude; sort sites by longitude then SHA256(Site ID) for ties; lower half is WEST_OPERATIONAL and upper half EAST_OPERATIONAL
geography.caution: these operational longitude blocks are not claimed identical to original paper's west/east survey sections

allowed_aggregates: total deployment rows and missing/invalid key, date or coordinate counts
unique stable physical site, camera-member, and site-period counts
site-periods with two named cameras, two camera stations and matched operational intervals
paired membership and interval-overlap totals in each operational geographic block
distinct calendar months covered by valid deployments in each operational block
per-block physical-site counts and site-longitude-separation summary without raw coordinates
number of spatially inconsistent site IDs (without listing IDs)
schema/metadata-only gates with no original G4 pass
